result.title: SCOPE-VSR: A Broad-Coverage Training Dataset for Video Super-Resolution
result.summary: Open-domain video super-resolution (VSR) requires temporally coherent details across widely varying scenes and subjects. However, existing training datasets are often semantically imbalanced and insufficiently diverse. We address this data bottleneck with a structured curation pipeline for open-domain VSR, SCOPE. In this pipeline, we combine task-oriented video selection with hierarchical semantic rebalancing. Applying this pipeline to a large-scale collection of data sources, we construct the SCOPE-VSR dataset for training and SCOPE-test for testing. SCOPE-VSR has approximately 27k videos and provides balanced and diverse coverage of various real-world scenarios and subjects. We further develop GraCo-VSR, a novel framework for one-step video restoration. GraCo-VSR adopts a reliability-aware design with explicit supervision to reduce degradation-induced distortions in motion and texture guidance, allowing the model to benefit more effectively from the diverse training content in SCOPE-VSR. Evaluations show that our model achieves strong reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality. Our code is available at: https://github.com/gyliao2768/SCOPE-VSR.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向开放域视频超分辨率的数据瓶颈，提出语义均衡的数据筛选流水线 SCOPE，构建约 2.7 万条视频的训练集 SCOPE-VSR 与测试集 SCOPE-test，并给出一步式视频复原框架 GraCo-VSR。
AI.relevance_reason: 主题为视频超分数据集与一步复原，虽含「可靠性感知监督」，但作用于运动与纹理引导的降质校正，不涉及多模态推理状态、视觉证据筛选或停止决策，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的具体联系。
